title: Austin Approves Industrial Land Rezonings
summary:
*   The council approved major land use changes, reclassifying four distinct properties from residential or commercial use to limited industrial services.
*   These rezonings were granted to First Gibralter Bank, impacting parcels along East Ben White Boulevard, Alvin Devane Boulevard, and East Oltorf.
*   All approvals included specific conditions attached, designed to manage future development and mitigate potential local impacts.
